component.name: freeglaz
component.summary: Drive an HP DesignJet Z9: printing and ICC color profiling

description.p: freeglaz is an open toolkit that drives an HP DesignJet Z9 for printing and ICC color profiling — native and custom (the latter via ArgyllCMS, which is bundled) — without the vendor's proprietary utilities.

ul.li: OS- and driver-independent pipeline: freeglaz drives the Z9 over its network interfaces.
Colorimetric non-interference: a 16-bit file is carried byte for byte to the printer's engine, no conversion.
Gloss Enhancer restricted to the image area.
Custom ICC profiling via ArgyllCMS, and the printer's built-in profiling.
A demo mode to explore the app without a printer.

description.p: freeglaz distributes no HP code. It is not affiliated with HP; HP and DesignJet are trademarks of their respective owners.
